shared.candidate_policy: R1/R2: first scheduled full fitted-frame pass or terminal state; R3-R5: terminal reached state, no intermediate checkpoint selection
shared.runtime_policy: CUDA training and CPU restore/inference must use separately qualified runtime profiles; measure versions and actual device use.

stages.question: Does correction preserve residual amplitude and sign?
stages.population: first/final snapshots of training parents only
stages.note: Algebraic fixed-operator probe, not new simulated trajectories.

stages.question: Can the unchanged seven-channel model fit one frame?
stages.gate: raw model passes target profile and physical limits on the fitted frame; no PCG counted as model success

stages.question: Does normalization obstruct fitting or amplitude?
stages.control: R1; identical surviving initialization, optimizer schedule, case and checkpoint locations
stages.entry: if R1 misses target or D0 identifies amplitude failure
stages.note: Separate runs; never remove GroupNorm and add amplitude scaling together. Define amplitude scaling before execution.

stages.question: Does a longer training budget or selected normalization change improve the existing cohort?
stages.training_population: existing 96 training frames; 48 validation frames excluded from updates
stages.entry: after resolving one-case fitting; paired initialization and sampling across variants

stages.question: Do two learned correction steps improve accuracy on model-generated residuals?
stages.entry: if R3 still needs iterative correction; keep architecture and loss fixed
stages.note: Backpropagate through correction/residual recomputation; record doubled model-call cost. No autonomous rollout claim.

stages.question: Does the frozen candidate generalize to new simulations and grids?
stages.entry: after selecting a working method; freeze splits and independent native seeds before capture
stages.note: Some shapes/resolutions must remain unseen during training. Real test-split support is a prerequisite. One-frame fixture first; reserved tests once after selection.

implementation_prerequisites: Implement explicit single-frame training selection and scheduled fitted-frame physics inspection before R1.
Implement D0 amplitude probes as labelled algebraic probes.
Define and verify each R2 normalization variant before any training.
Represent genuine reserved test splits before R5; never relabel them as validation.
conditional_replan: If one-case fitting remains unsuccessful, inspect optimization and coarse-grid communication before enlarging the model or data cohort.
execution_visibility: Existing Tuldok catalog owns CUDA training Runs and CPU restore/inference Runs, with actual device and VRAM evidence; Rheon egui observes native CPU simulation/diagnostics. No isolated training catalog.
scope_correction: CPU-first applies to deployment inference, not training. All proposed optimizer work requires CUDA. The 600-second limit is elapsed wall time, not CPU time.
